tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Search MapleV's Tesla Model 3 / Model Y collision parts catalog by keyword, OE part number, vehicle model, or category. Returns matching parts with names, OE numbers, grade, category, and CAD list price.

tools.name: get_part
tools.description: Look up a single MapleV part by its catalog id (e.g. 'P-001') or by any Tesla OE part number / variant. Returns full details including grade, fitment, and CAD list price.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all part categories in the MapleV Tesla collision catalog with the number of SKUs in each.

tools.name: get_delivery_options
tools.description: Given a delivery city in British Columbia (and optionally the province), return MapleV's available delivery tiers with ETA, cut-off time and CAD fee.
